clauses.heading: Position
clauses.text: The Employee is employed as a Sales Associate at the Company's 28 May Street outlet in Baku.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: This contract is for a fixed term from 5 January 2026 to 31 December 2026.

clauses.heading: Working hours
clauses.text: The Employee shall work forty (40) hours per week, from 09:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break.

clauses.heading: Salary
clauses.text: The Employee's gross monthly salary is AZN 1,400, paid on the last working day of each month.

clauses.heading: Annual leave
clauses.text: The Employee is entitled to twenty-one (21) calendar days of paid annual leave per year.

clauses.heading: Sick leave entitlement
clauses.text: The Employee is entitled to up to fourteen (14) days of sick leave per calendar year at full pay.

clauses.heading: Notification of sickness
clauses.text: The Employee shall notify her line manager by 10:00 on the first day of any sickness absence.

clauses.heading: Medical certificate
clauses.text: For any sickness absence of more than two (2) consecutive working days, the Employee shall provide a medical certificate within three (3) working days of returning to work. Sick leave without a required certificate is unpaid.

clauses.heading: Notice
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this contract by giving thirty (30) days' written notice.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The Employee shall not disclose the Company's customer lists or pricing during or after employment.
